items.name: map
items.title: Map
items.description: Interactive vector map for React and Next.js that follows your shadcn theme: light and dark with your theme toggle, and markers, clusters, popups and attribution in your design tokens. Street map data included, no API key or account.
items.docs: The map is defined in tileflow.config.ts. Prepare it with your framework's Tileflow integration so it is served at /tileflow/manifest.json. Next.js: wrap next.config with withTileflow from @tileflow/next and add the map-next item (https://tileflow.dev/r/react/map-next.json). Vite (React Router, TanStack Start): add tileflow() from @tileflow/vite to the plugins in vite.config.ts. Then render <Map /> inside an element with a height.

items.name: map-next
items.title: Map setup for Next.js
items.description: The route that serves the map while next dev runs. Wrap next.config with withTileflow from @tileflow/next as well.
items.docs: Wrap your Next.js config: import { withTileflow } from "@tileflow/next" and export default withTileflow({ ...yourConfig }). In development it sends /tileflow/* to this route; next build writes the prepared map to public/tileflow.

items.name: map-marker
items.title: Map marker
items.description: Map pin and price tag markers in your primary colour, with an active state for the selected or hovered item.

items.name: map-popup
items.title: Map popup
items.description: Header, title, description and footer parts for map popups, laid out like a shadcn Card on your popover surface.

items.name: map-controls
items.title: Map controls
items.description: Show-my-location and full-screen buttons for the map, using your shadcn Button.

items.name: store-locator
items.title: Store locator
items.description: Store locator: a searchable store list synced with an interactive map, filters by store type, clustered markers, popups with directions, and nearest-first sorting from the visitor's location. Uses your shadcn theme in light and dark. Replace the sample stores with your own data. No API key.
items.docs: Render <StoreLocator stores={stores} categories={storeCategories} /> in any page with a height, and replace the sample stores in components/store-locator/stores.ts with yours. The map needs its framework setup: see the map item.
